# IT System Architecture and Security Review

This document details several key action items concerning the bank's IT system architecture and security posture.

## Action Items:

*   Investigate firewall settings based on audit findings.
*   Optimize API latency standards and update accordingly.
*   Review encryption standards for the 2026 strategy.
*   Perform quarterly updates to firewall settings.
*   Implement urgent updates to firewall settings.
